label: sound
instruction_covers: Public factories create_option_by_file, create_option (alias), create_option_by_env (default JM_OPTION_PATH), create_option_by_str (YAML by default), JmOption.from_file, JmOption.construct (cover_default=True), JmOption.default()
default() fills cwd base_dir, default client impl, retry count, decode, cache, plugin valid
by_str deep-merges and decides the .webp suffix while keeping other defaults; by_file/create_option remember filepath so to_file() saves back
by_env loads the named variable; unset or empty raises the library validation exception naming the variable
construct deep-merges partial dicts without mutating unrelated default branches
construct honors log false (disable) and log pretty (pretty logging)
construct migrates batch_count into threading.image, plugin into plugins, and zip levels so album-level runs after albums and photo-level after photos
cover_default=False builds directly from the complete dict
notes: Repo verified at complete extract: JmOption/JmModuleConfig/option_default_dict/deconstruct/to_filejm_logger/PrettyFormatter/JmcomicException all pre-exist; none of the seven factories exist, so they are the stated new API (R1 names). ExceptionTool.raises defaults to JmcomicException, and the repo already validates env vars that way (jm_toolkit match_os_env), so the exception type and naming are the repo pattern. Expected values are derived from option_default_dict/deconstruct, not literals. The no-mutation, referential-transparency, cross-process, and no-file-or-network tests are all satisfied by any minimal correct in-memory deep-merge implementation; they guard against unreasonable implementations rather than pinning unstated behaviour. The zip direction (album-level after albums, photo-level after photos) plus the repo level semantics and after_album/after_photo filename defaults determine the migration outcome.
